text:
Nina (People Ops): Heads-up: we're updating the parental leave section in the handbook to harmonize accrual language and add a 'keep in touch' flexible return-to-work plan. Goal: clearer examples and a short template managers can use. Draft: https://handbook.internal.redwood/policies/parental-leave-update-v2 :sparkling_heart:

Omar (HRIS): Will need schema changes for RTW_plan field and leave_contact_person in the HR database. I'll prep a migration and coordinate with eng for a small portal change.

Cam (Benefits): Any change to pay continuation percentages? Also need to update local country examples (UK statutory pay vs Redwood top-up).

Nina (People Ops): No change to pay levels in this draft; just clearer examples and manager template. We will, however, add a section on statutory vs company top-up so folks know which applies in each country.

legal-bot: Automated legal checklist: please include policy_effective_date, jurisdiction_scope, and record_retention_period. Also note items requiring local counsel review.

i18n-team: Will queue EN->FR/DE/ES after final text freeze. Typical turnaround 5 business days. Please flag any in-text variables (e.g., {employee_name}, {leave_start}) so translators keep placeholders consistent.

Omar (HRIS): Migration plan: add nullable fields rtw_plan TEXT, leave_contact_person STRING; add index on employee_id. Will schedule migration during low-traffic window next weekend.

Nina (People Ops): Manager template example (short):
"""
Hi {employee_name},
Congrats on your upcoming addition.
Per the company policy, you are eligible for X weeks of leave. Let's plan a 30-min RTW check-in two weeks prior to return. Proposed flexible RTW: 4 weeks at 60% time then full-time. Please confirm.
Thanks, {manager_name}
"""

Cam (Benefits): Can we add a link to benefits enrollment deadlines and contact for benefit continuation? A small callout near the top would help.

Nina (People Ops): Good call, will add enrollment deadlines and links. Also adding a short checklist for managers with timelines and who's responsible.

Omar (HRIS): Once migration is done, portal will show RTW plan as a collapsible section on the leave request page. I'll attach mock screenshots after the migration.

Nina (People Ops): Action items: 1) Legal to confirm jurisdictional callouts. 2) Omar to run migration next weekend. 3) i18n to prepare translations after freeze. 4) People Ops to schedule manager training drop-in next Thurs.

Cam (Benefits): Will draft benefits continuation callout and share by EOD Tues.

Nina (People Ops): I'll publish final draft and run the e-sign ack requirement for employees who take parental leave after the effective date. We'll track acks via HR export similar to other policies. I'll post the export SQL when ready.
